title: MCP System Complete: Client-Independent Quantum Processing Unit Access
statement: Completed comprehensive Model Context Protocol (MCP) implementation enabling client-independent discovery and verification of quantum factorization baselines. System provides standard problem-centric URIs (qpu://rsa/{problem}/{method}), complete classical factorization algorithm reference, and explicitly tracked open research items. All 121 tests passing (84 unit + 13 remote + 24 protocol verification). Ready for production use.
